subject: SEND - New notification from ${notification.sender.paDenomination} - ${notification.iun}
body1: <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>You have<#else>Your business has received at <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>your<#else>its digital domicile a legally binding notification from ${notification.sender.paDenomination} with IUN code ${notification.iun}, log in to SEND to view it.
body2: This SEND notification will be legally delivered <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>to you </#if>7 days* after receipt at <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>your<#else>the</#if> digital domicile, even if you do not open or read it.
perfection: <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>You have<#else>The business has</#if> 120 days from the moment the legally binding notification is delivered to view the documents online. After that, they will no longer be available on SEND and <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>you will have to contact<#else>it will have to contact</#if> the institution that sent them<#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'> to you</#if>.
payment: The deadline for payment, if applicable, and for any appeals is indicated in the documents.
banner: With the digital domicile, <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>you will not receive paper notices and you will no longer have to<#else>your business will not receive paper notices and will no longer have to</#if> bear the shipping costs for registered mail.
footnote: *If <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>you<#else>the business</#if> received the SEND notification after 9:00 PM, the 7 days run from the following day.
footer: You are receiving this email because you entered <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>your address<#else>the company email address as a contact detail on SEND. To change your contact details or add others, go to your contact details.
